proof_strip.use_when: Three short, verified proof points are available.

testimonial.use_when: A genuine attributed testimonial directly supports the message.

benefit_stack.use_when: The reader needs fast clarity on why the product matters.

guarantee.use_when: The client has a real, enforceable guarantee or return promise.

offer_box.use_when: A genuine promotion or value add is central to the decision.

social_proof_quote.use_when: Short credible third-party proof is available.

urgency_truth.job: Create action from a real deadline
urgency_truth.use_when: Stock, access or a deadline is objectively time-limited.

founder_note.use_when: Founder perspective genuinely adds trust or context.

next_steps.use_when: The customer needs to know what happens after purchase or signup.

delivery_reassurance.use_when: Delivery timing, returns or fulfilment are known objections.

comparison.use_when: Two options serve meaningfully different customer needs.

vip_access.use_when: The customer has earned real access, treatment or value.

mechanism.use_when: Understanding the mechanism materially improves purchase confidence.
